tiers.name: quick-native
tiers.requires: bundled data only; no Python engine/history; corpus integration targets gated by full-parity

tiers.name: service-contract
tiers.requires: built server, bundled smoke-game.json, locked websockets; disposable processes/databases

tiers.name: full-differential
tiers.when: engine changes, release candidates, weekly backstop
tiers.requires: every retained corpus payload; missing files fail preflight; GOA2_FIXTURE_CACHE optional

tiers.name: restore-exhaustive
tiers.requires: verified complete data and setup/view sources; not established by quick-native

tiers.name: performance-strength
tiers.requires: frozen content/source, fixed work and paired runs; expensive opt-in

tiers.name: hosted-integration
tiers.requires: explicit compatible frontend/deployment; never an implicit external mutation

tiers.name: setup-parity
tiers.when: setup/content changes, weekly reference backstop and release
tiers.requires: Explicit admitted inputs and nonzero test selection; see verification-gates.json

tiers.name: view-parity
tiers.when: view/privacy changes, weekly reference backstop and release
tiers.requires: Explicit admitted inputs and nonzero test selection; see verification-gates.json

tiers.name: timed-bot-native
tiers.requires: Explicit admitted inputs and nonzero test selection; see verification-gates.json
